address: GF, Paresa Resort, 49 Mu 6, Layi-Nakhale Road, Kamala, Kathu, Phuket, 83150, Thailand
bio: The views from Paresa Resort, high on a clifftop, are breathtaking at sunset. It’s an idyllic spot to sip cocktails, before moving to the terrace for sumptuous southern and central Thai cuisine. Start with mixed Thai canapés or the soft shell crab miang, followed by the fragrant stir-fried Phuket lobster. Don't forget to save room for the Thai-styled dessert....
